entries.test: Surveys from around late 2024 on the share of people or professionals who had tried generative AI tools, and how satisfied they were with them.
entries.note: "Practically everyone" is loose, but most readers would read it as a very high trial rate.

entries.test: Whether the October 2024 CNBC Technology Executive Council survey reported that 79% of respondents had tried Microsoft Copilot.
entries.note: The "refutation" part is his reading of the figure. Only the 79% trial rate can be checked against evidence.

entries.test: Whether the October 2024 CNBC Technology Executive Council survey reported that about 25% of respondents said Copilot was worth it.
entries.note: He also reports that a quarter said it was not worth it and half said it was too soon to tell.

entries.test: Surveys from late 2024 showing high trial rates for generative AI alongside a large share of users saying it was too soon to judge its value.
entries.note: This is a broad generalisation drawn from one executive survey. It is graded on the plain reading: high trial rates plus undecided users.
